verdict.rationale: Slate documents background subagents and message queuing inside an interactive TUI session, plus a permission-bypass flag. Nothing in the evidence shows always-on agents started by a recurring schedule or by event triggers to maintain or fix software autonomously. In-session background orchestration and queuing are adjacent features, not scheduled or triggered autonomy.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can set up always-on agents that run on schedules or triggers to maintain and fix my software autonomously
